metadata.hierarchy: Custom editorial thematic hierarchy; not an official IAB hierarchy.
metadata.code_policy: Every category has a unique lowercase r0_code. Scalar taxonomy fields hold primary codes. All original codes are retained exactly once in sources; explicitly merged aliases may have multiple source entries from one dictionary.
metadata.merge_policy: Reviewed equivalent categories merged; original source records retained. Same-dictionary aliases may coexist in sources while scalar fields retain one primary code.
metadata.name_policy: Custom section labels for roots; source name for other categories. All original names are retained in sources.
metadata.tier_policy: Top-level tier is custom tree depth. source tier and tier_1..tier_4 remain original.
metadata.placement_policy: 32 curated themes with explicit product/topic overrides; original finer parent relationships reused within the same theme. Primary source order: content_3_1, adproduct_2_0, content_1_0.
metadata.limitations: Matching names across dictionaries is an editorial correspondence, not an official assertion that content and advertised products are interchangeable. Scope remains limited to source categories; no unsupported AI Chat or other invented code.

hierarchy_adjustments.reason: Pornography is a narrower category of Adult & Explicit Sexual Content.

custom_codes.description: Original custom-source identifiers, retained for provenance. Universal hierarchy identifiers are in r0_code.

additions.fields_scope: Descriptions and keywords added to the 63 new categories only; existing entries are unchanged.
keyword_rules: New-category phrases contain no full category or source name as a token-bounded phrase
additions.keyword_limitations: Lexical uniqueness is validated. Semantic exclusivity cannot be guaranteed for related parent/child categories; these phrases are classification hints, not exhaustive mutually exclusive matching rules.

fields.iab_code: Official Content Taxonomy 1.0 code or null.
fields.r0_code: Unique lowercase hierarchical identifier for every category.
fields.cattax_id: Ad Product Taxonomy 2.0 category ID or null.
fields.c3_1_code: Content Taxonomy 3.1 category ID or null.
fields.r0_parent: Immediate parent r0_code, or null for a root.

iab_descriptions_import.description_scope: User-provided descriptions of Content Taxonomy 1.0 categories, copied verbatim; references to original parents do not redefine the custom hierarchy.

r0_hierarchy.scope: Every category; root parent is null in JSON and empty in CSV.
r0_hierarchy.source_codes: Custom source codes remain in sources[].code as provenance, separate from the universal r0_code.

match_review.method: Manual review of unmatched official legacy migration pairs and fuzzy name candidates; broad mappings are not automatically merged.
